topic: When a headache means see a doctor

scenes.line: Five headache red flags worth taking seriously.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira faces camera, serious but warm, holds up five fingers; five teal flag icons stack in beside her
scenes.animation: Hard cut in. Flag icons fly in one by one on 'Three', 'headache', 'flags', scale 0.5 to 1.0, back.out 0.3 s each

scenes.line: A sudden, severe headache — the worst you have ever felt — is a medical emergency.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, wide eyes, one palm raised in a stop gesture; a bold lightning bolt on a soft-cream card at upper right
scenes.animation: Lightning bolt flicks in on 'sudden', scale 0.6 to 1.0, elastic.out 0.4 s; card pulses once on 'emergency'

scenes.visual: Bold teal circle with a phone handset icon and three radiating arc lines on a cream background
scenes.animation: Circle scales up from 0 on 'Call', power2.out 0.3 s; arcs draw outward on 'immediately'

scenes.line: A headache with a stiff neck, high fever, or a rash on the skin
scenes.visual: Three rounded cards side by side: neck with a tension-arc indicator, thermometer in alert-red, skin patch with a dot pattern
scenes.animation: Cards slide up one by one on 'neck', 'fever', 'rash', stagger 0.15 s, power2.out

scenes.line: can be a sign of meningitis. Get medical help fast.
scenes.visual: Teal medical-cross badge expands over the three cards; label 'See a doctor' slides in; arrow pointing to a clinic-building outline
scenes.animation: Badge scales 0 to 1 on 'meningitis', power2.out 0.35 s; arrow draws on 'fast'

scenes.line: If a headache comes with sudden vision changes, weakness on one side of the body, or trouble speaking,
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, earnest look, counts on three fingers; eye icon, body-half outline, and speech-bubble icon float at the sides
scenes.animation: Each icon pops in on its matching word: eye on 'vision', half-body on 'weakness', speech bubble on 'speaking', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: those can be signs of a stroke. Call emergency services.
scenes.visual: Warning triangle with a brain outline inside; phone-handset icon appears below it
scenes.animation: Triangle scales up on 'stroke', power2.out 0.35 s; phone icon fades in on 'emergency'

scenes.line: After a head injury, a headache with confusion or vomiting needs a doctor, not just rest.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, calm but concerned, gentle raised-hand gesture; head-outline with a bump icon and a stethoscope icon beside her
scenes.animation: Head-bump icon fades in on 'head injury', stethoscope slides in on 'doctor', power2.out 0.3 s each

scenes.line: A headache that gets steadily worse over days or weeks,
scenes.visual: Line chart labeled 'Pain level' on the y-axis, days 1-7 on the x-axis; a teal line climbs steadily from left to right
scenes.animation: Chart axes draw on 'steadily'; teal line traces from day 1 to day 7 as the words are spoken, power1.inOut

scenes.line: with no clear cause, is worth bringing to your doctor.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, warm smile, open-palm gesture; a small calendar card with a stethoscope cross appears beside her
scenes.animation: Calendar card pops in on 'doctor', scale 0 to 1, back.out 0.3 s

scenes.line: Save this. And if any of these match, talk to a doctor right away.
scenes.visual: Dr. Ira, direct gaze, points upward toward a bookmark icon, then gives a friendly nod
scenes.animation: Bookmark icon bounces twice on 'Save', scale 0.8 to 1.1 to 1.0, back.out; gentle fade toward end card on 'right away'

scenes.visual: Cream end card with Pulse Health wordmark centred
scenes.onScreenText: Not medical advice. Sources: NHS, CDC
